description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various models on a zero-shot classification task, comparing performance across five different configurations: RoBERTa w/o Exp. (light gray), ExEnt (light blue), LaSQuE (mean) (orange), LaSQuE (green), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) (dark gray). The vertical y-axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 40% to 65% with tick marks at 5% intervals. The horizontal x-axis lists the five model variants without explicit axis labeling, arranged in the order shown in the legend. The RoBERTa w/o Exp. baseline achieves approximately 47% accuracy. ExEnt improves to about 55%, while LaSQuE (mean) and LaSQuE (without curriculum) both hover around 47–48%. The highest-performing model, LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum), reaches approximately 62% accuracy, significantly outperforming all others. The bars are grouped side-by-side for direct comparison, with no stacking or error bars shown. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner, clearly mapping each color to its corresponding model variant. The chart visually emphasizes the substantial gain from incorporating synthetic-to-real curriculum learning into the LaSQuE framework.
